maybe prior,
I've been jumping from dx11 to vulkan to test FPS, with rebar on/off ;
-high -mainthreadpriorirty -threads 13 +engine_low_latency_... I can't remember this one,
But I have never had Vulkan crash on me for a very long time. I miss it though.

CS2 got a vulkan stability patch the other day, compare that source 2 vulkan and dota's, and I think Vulkan needs the same updates to vulkan that CS2 is getting... [/quote]

You are comparing basic controller and launch option workarounds from 2019 with a major low-level architectural failure of Source 2 in 2026

The -nojoy option simply disables controller polling, while parameters like -high, -mainthreadpriority, -threads 13, and engine low-latency variables merely adjust CPU thread scheduling and priority states.
